mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and volume depletion can potentiate orthostatic hypotension and dizziness caused by carbidopa-levodopa, while loop diuretics may reduce levodopa efficacy through altered gastric pH and reduced absorption.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes, and Parkinson's symptom control; ensure adequate hydration and consider potassium supplementation; assess for additive orthostatic effects and adjust dosing if necessary.
